recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14754 unless PA changes the broader Patient.gender link visibility approach.
issue_request: FHIR-14754 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Patient and asked to remove "Gender of individual drives many clinical processes" from Patient.gender requirements, then add a Patient Gender section pointer in Patient.gender comments.
initial_application: Commit c407909a65666cce8ff7125b52f3bd7a2f95f47b explicitly applied GF#14754 by changing source/patient/patient-spreadsheet.xml to remove the clinical-process sentence and add the Patient Gender and Sex pointer to Patient.gender comments. Current Patient source was later converted to structuredefinition XML in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157.
additional_context: FHIR-16453 was a later same-family follow-up that asked to apply this tracker in R4. FHIR-29673 refreshed the linked Patient Gender and Sex guidance for R5. FHIR-44895 later improved link visibility, with PA minutes approving definition placement because the proposed short-display placement was not possible with tooling.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current build-scope source has no occurrence of the removed clinical-process sentence, describes Patient.gender as administrative, and links to the Patient Gender and Sex section from the definition. Moving the link back into the comment would conflict with the later FHIR-44895 placement decision and add redundant guidance.
